column4: White  Rose  Foundation
(Incorporation)
to provide opportunities and financial assistance to
individuals  with  varied  talents  to  grow  their  full
potential;
to provide opportunities for youth to learn new skills
and receive on job training and assist them to set up
small scale businesses within their communities;
to  provide  accounting,  financial,  legal  and  other
professional support and advise to any community in
Sri Lanka, to help them manage their lives in a better
way;
to promote social, spiritual and cultural activities to
intergrate  the  different  communities  in  the  country
and  increase  awareness  and  understanding  among
them about each other;
to  establish  island-wide  information  technology
centres for the advancement of scientific studies and
development of the country;
to  provide facilities for the agricultural and fisheries
industries where necessary;
to    provide  assistance  to  governmental  and  non
governmental  agencies  for  generating  employment
amongst  youth;
to  obtain  and  provide  grants  and  other  forms  of
financial  assistance  for  the  commencement  and
advancement of the above mentioned projects;
to  co-ordinate  with  like  minded  persons  and
organizations both local and foreign, and to organize
meetings,  seminars,  conferences  etc.  for  the
advancement of the above mentioned project;
